description: Principal can assume an administrator role
evidence: user:alice is allowed sts:AssumeRole on arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/admin-role | role:admin-role trusts user:alice | role:admin-role has unconditional administrator-level permissions

description: Principal can create keys for an administrator user
evidence: user:bob is allowed iam:CreateAccessKey on arn:aws:iam::123456789012:user/admin-user | user:admin-user has unconditional administrator-level permissions

description: Principal can pass an administrator role to Lambda
evidence: user:alice is allowed iam:PassRole on arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/lambda-admin | user:alice has unconditional Lambda create/invoke permissions on * | role:lambda-admin trusts the Lambda service | role:lambda-admin has unconditional administrator-level permissions

description: Role can modify its own permissions
evidence: role:dev is allowed iam:PutRolePolicy on arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/dev

description: Principal can version a managed policy that grants its permissions
evidence: user:editor is allowed iam:CreatePolicyVersion on arn:aws:iam::123456789012:policy/DeveloperPolicy | The affected managed policy is attached to the principal or one of its groups

description: User can attach a managed policy to itself
evidence: user:alice is allowed iam:AttachUserPolicy on arn:aws:iam::123456789012:user/alice | This permission can enable self-escalation unless policy selection is constrained

description: Principal can weaken an administrator role trust policy
evidence: user:alice is allowed iam:UpdateAssumeRolePolicy on arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/admin-role | role:admin-role has unconditional administrator-level permissions | Changing trust is a privilege-escalation prerequisite; it does not alone prove successful role assumption
